description:
Modernizes Java applications by upgrading the Java version and updating dependencies to compatible versions — improving security, performance, and maintainability while keeping the project buildable at every step.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to upgrade Java versions, migrate from javax to Jakarta EE, update Spring Boot, modernize dependencies, or do any kind of Java version migration — even if they phrase it as "upgrade to Java 21", "migrate to Spring Boot 3", "update dependencies", "fix javax imports", "modernize the project", or "update to Jakarta".
This skill covers: build system readiness, Jakarta EE namespace migration, database/ORM modernization, core dependency updates, Spring ecosystem upgrades, and final integration verification. Always use this skill for Java upgrade or dependency modernization tasks.
Triggers: "upgrade java", "migrate to java 17/21", "update spring boot", "javax to jakarta", "modernize dependencies", "update pom.xml", "dependency upgrades", "java version migration".
